notes.title: Chains of Freedom – Update #1.0.3
notes.content: [p][b]Hey, dear players![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and all the valuable feedback you’ve shared in your reviews and forum posts! The wait is over – here’s the list of improvements in the latest build we’ve been working on:[/p][list][*][p]Added a much-requested Turn Limit toggle to Settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how ammunition is presented to the player: "ammo in clip / total clip capacity (inventory stock)".[/p][/*][*][p]Added exit prompts in areas that you cannot return to.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised loot discovery radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased ammo drops in most levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased material drops in multiple mid-game levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed or reduced enemy waves in many combat encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more Crystal slots in Places of Power after losing a character to compensate for lost quick slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Peacekeeper’s Overwatch ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted or removed specific tough enemies in some encounters to ease difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added or adjusted loot during/after combat, especially extra ammo or consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quality-of-life mechanics, such as auto-removal of unused quest items and clearer indicators.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance and stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check it out and let us know what you think![/p]

notes.title: Даталпое жукотя орауджямт: Обзор Chains of Freedom
notes.content: Когда на Землю упал метеорит с таинственной субстанцией, вызывающей дичайшие мутации, Суверенное государство встало на защиту человечества. Да, по косвенным признакам оно кажется тоталитарной тюрьмой народов, зато у людей есть шанс пережить вторжение инопланетной заразы. Впрочем, не все хотят выменивать безопасность за свободу, поэтому отряду «миротворцев» необходимо найти и ликвидировать известного бузотера доктора Светлова, дабы ничто не будоражило умы сограждан.

Hey everyone!

notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback! Improvements and What's Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
 
After more than two years of development, our game is finally in your hands — and we couldn't be more excited! We want to take a moment to thank everyone who’s played so far and shared their feedback. You're awesome!
 
Right now, we’re fully focused on gathering feedback. Once we’ve gone through everything, we’ll get to work on improvements. So if you have thoughts, ideas, or issues to report, please let us know!
 
A couple of things we’re already looking into:
[list]

[*] Turn limitation on Hard difficulty — we hear you, and we’re exploring possible solutions.
[*] Localization — we've seen some reports and are actively working on fixes.
[*] The way ammunition load is presented.
[*] Audio leveling adjustments.
[*] Improvements based on your feedback.
[/list]
 
Thanks again for being part of this journey with us!

notes.title: Chains of Freedom is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
 
Our game is finally out — and we just wanted to take a moment, a real one, to say thank you. From the bottom of our hearts.
 
We’re a small team within Nordcurrent with big dreams, and this game has been a labor of love every step of the way — we poured everything into this because we [i]love[/i] making games. We love storytelling, world-building, creating moments for players to feel something real.
 
And the fact that there’s a community out there can now [i]play[/i] what we made? That means more than we can ever put into words. You’re not just playing a game — you’re supporting a team, allowing us to grow and create new, better experiences. A team of people who believe that heart and soul still belong in game development.
 
Thank you for believing in us. For your patience, your curiosity, and your support.
 
We can’t wait to hear what you think. We can’t wait to keep building.
 
With love,
the Chains of Freedom Team

notes.title: Chains of Freedom (PS5) Review
notes.content:
The strategy turn-based tactics genre is a hard one to break into, mostly because a few games have already nailed it down to near perfection. XCOM, Fire Emblem, and Wasteland have basically set the blueprint, and they’ve done it so well that any new entry has to work extra hard to stand out. But that doesn’t mean there isn’t room for something new to shake things up a bit. Chains of Freedom definitely tries to do just that.

Chains of Freedom, developed by Nordcurrent, drops us into a post-apocalyptic Eastern Europe where everything is falling apart. You play as a squad of soldiers who are shot down behind enemy lines. The team is split up during the crash, and the early hours of the game revolve around reuniting with your squadmates — well, some of them. It’s not long before the group uncovers a much more significant threat: shady government conspiracies and rogue scientists experimenting with things they definitely shouldn’t.
